shared_binding_fields.source_digest_sha256: required future exact full64hex sourceDigest, starts with already reported92a908; no invented digest algorithm

artifact_descriptor.path: public path under research-wiki/ or runs/ only; no other actors private paths
artifact_descriptor.compression: optional gzip for raw image/log archive

actual_46_image_review_required.images: exactly46 distinct id entries, each actual_reviewed=true, decision=accepted, nonempty actual notes, image descriptor and raw_image_sha256; raw PNG/JPEG bytes are hash-bound

nine_actual_checks_required.checks: exactly9 authorized distinct ids; each has exact public receipt/log descriptors. Each raw receipt needs actual command, exit_code/returncode0, start+completion/duration, future checked core/head_after and matching raw log digest. head_before if present must also equal future core.

provenance_rule: Use actual independent reader findings and actual completed process receipts. Mechanical exports/projections must preserve original raw artifacts and their exact hashes; examples/schema fields cannot manufacture acceptance. If actual immutable receipts cannot satisfy a required field, stop with a typed metadata mismatch before API; do not invent PASS or loosen guards silently.
